label: Operation Epic Fury begins
description: U.S.-led campaign starts at 1:15 a.m.; 100+ aircraft strike 1000+ targets in opening 24 hours.

label: Iran retaliates; first US dead
description: Iranian attacks on US/UK tankers and bases in Kuwait and Bahrain; first US fatalities reported.

label: Hormuz paralysis starts
description: Iraq shuts in ~1.5 mbpd crude; Qatar halts LNG output; tankers unable to traverse Hormuz.

label: Israeli strikes hit Tehran/Alborz fuel depots
description: Israeli strikes on Tehran and Alborz refineries; extensive fires and toxic plume over Tehran.

label: KC-135 loss and tanker attacks
description: US KC-135 crash in Iraq kills six airmen; tanker attacks halt Iraqi oil exports; Brent at $119.50.

label: Iran strikes Qatar LNG infrastructure
description: Major damage at Ras Laffan; 17% of Qatar LNG capacity knocked out for 3-5 years; European gas +35%.

label: US 15-point settlement proposal
description: US sends Iran a 15-point plan; diplomacy moves into a more structured phase.

label: Iran strikes loaded tanker off Dubai
description: Brent rose 64% in March to about $118; Pakistan and China call for immediate ceasefire.

label: Trump vows harder phase of attacks
description: Brent closes $109.03; WTI $111.54 after Trump promises "extremely hard" strikes.

label: Pakistan-brokered ceasefire announced
description: Two-week US-Iran ceasefire; fighting continues; Brent falls below $100.

label: US blockade of Iranian ports begins
description: Blockade imposed in response to near-total halt of Hormuz shipping; reciprocal maritime strangulation.

label: Ceasefire extended; Pakistan talks continue
description: Tehran "positively reviewing" participation; Trump extends ceasefire while awaiting Iranian proposal.

label: Brent reaches four-year high
description: Brent touches $126.41 intraday (highest since March 2022); talks deadlocked; Hormuz constrained.

label: Epic Fury declared over; ceasefire stress-tested
description: Rubio: "Operation Epic Fury is concluded". Within 48h serious exchange of fire near Hormuz.

label: Draft 60-day truce framework emerges
description: US and Iranian sources agree framework to extend truce 60 days and permit shipping; final approval pending.
